{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the highest sample_seq
df["sample_seq"] = pd.to_numeric(df["sample_seq"], errors='coerce')

df_sorted = df.sort_values(by=["patient_id", "sample_seq"], ascending=[True, False])
df_dedup = df_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset="patient_id", keep="first")

# Check severity distribution in deduplicated data
print("Deduplicated severity distribution:")
print(df_dedup["severity"].value_counts())

# Compute overall response rates by arm (across all severity)
treat_resp = df_dedup[df_dedup["arm"] == "treatment"]["responded"].mean()
control_resp = df_dedup[df_dedup["arm"] == "control"]["responded"].mean()
raw_diff = treat_resp - control_resp

# Now compute stratum-specific response rates and risk differences
stratum_diffs = []
for severity in df_dedup["severity"].unique():
    df_sev = df_dedup[df_dedup["severity"] == severity]
    treat_sev = df_sev[df_sev["arm"] == "treatment"]["responded"].mean()
    control_sev = df_sev[df_sev["arm"] == "control"]["responded"].mean()
    diff = treat_sev - control_sev
    stratum_diffs.append({
        "severity": severity,
        "treat_resp": treat_sev,
        "control_resp": control_sev,
        "diff": diff
    })

stratum_df = pd.DataFrame(stratum_diffs)
print("\nStratum-level risk differences:")
print(stratum_df)

# Compute weighted average risk difference by stratum size
stratum_size = df_dedup.groupby("severity").size()
weights = stratum_size / stratum_size.sum()
weighted_diff = (stratum_df["diff"] * weights).sum()

print(f"\nStratum sizes: {stratum_size.to_dict()}")
print(f"Stratum weights: {weights.to_dict()}")
print(f"Weighted average risk difference: {weighted_diff:.6f}")

# Print raw difference for comparison
print(f"\nRaw difference (treatment - control): {raw_diff:.6f}")"}
